description: IdentityMatchResponse indicates which packages the user is eligible for. The ttl_sec field defines a caching contract.

eligible_package_ids.description: Package IDs the user is eligible for. Packages not listed are ineligible.

ttl_sec.description: How long the router should cache this response, in seconds. 0 means do not cache.

tmpx.description: HPKE-encrypted exposure token from a single buyer agent. The router collects these into tmpx_providers keyed by provider ID.

tmpx_providers.description: Provider-keyed TMPX tokens. Populated by the router during merge.
